sources.sourceOrg: Polk County Board of County Commissioners — Charter §2.1
sources.quote:
There shall be five county commissioners' districts in Polk County, which shall be 
numbered one to five, inclusive, and shall be as nearly equal in proportion to population 
as possible. There shall be one county commissioner for each of such districts, who shall 
be elected by the qualified voters of the county.

District4 is the candidate residence seat, not a geographic voter restriction; countywide scope is legally established, not a county fallback.

Ordinance No. 864, effective on November 5, 2018, amends the acreage to 145.28 acres.
